title: Tidy Cedar Clarity

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 minutes while airing the room after tidying.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist linens lightly from a distance.

why_it_works: Bright lemon lifts stale air while crisp eucalyptus and dry cedarwood add a clean, grounding finish.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
